title: 第7章 离婚
novel_title: 听我解释，真不是你们想的那样！
content_zh:
炼丹峰。

    “今天把你们叫过来，是有事要和你们说！”

    聚会的餐桌上，陆沉，林天，张帆，玉凝，庄静白等人都坐在一起，看向首座的男人王峰。

    他是炼丹峰的首席弟子。

    “什么事啊王师兄，把我们都叫过来了，这么大阵仗！”张帆喝了一杯灵酒问道。

    “我……和离了。”

    “什么？！”众人大惊，以为自己听错了。

    “你逗我们玩呢吧师兄，你和怀玉师姐感情那么好，过的那么幸福，你们就是神仙眷侣，怎么可能会和离？”

    “是真的，是我的问题……唉，都怪那该死的黑市，都怪那该死的合欢宗！！”

    王峰深吸了一口气，目光仇恨。

    陆沉闻言，身体微不可察的抖了一下。

    “到底怎么回事？怀玉师姐她不可能背叛你啊！”

    “唉，我说出来，也不怕你们笑话！”

    王峰叹了一口气。

    “我天生质量很差，能有的概率很小，于是，我就在黑市找了个偏方，说是把我和姜怀玉的都拿出来，体外。”

    “这不是正常的吗，难不成是后面出什么事了？”

    “是，一开始是很正常，可谁知道……”

    说到这里，王峰一脸的痛苦。

    “谁知道，黑市里的人，竟然偷偷更换了我的，换成了那个人的！！”

    此话一出，场面顿时安静了下来。

    因为他们也没想到，事情会这样发展，并且最关键的是，师姐姜怀玉并没有犯错，她也是受害者。

    “师兄，你这……”

    张帆张了张嘴，一时竟不知该说什么。

    他下意识看向身边的玉凝，后者也是一脸震惊，并且脸色有些苍白。

    手都在抖！

    林天则是皱着眉头，把手中的灵酒放下：“王师兄，这事……怀玉师姐知道吗？”

    “她知道。”王峰苦笑。

    “她比我知道得还早。灵儿三岁的时候，她就发现了不对劲，偷偷去做了验证，发现果然不是！但她不敢告诉我，一个人扛了三年。”

    “三年？”庄静白收回看向陆沉的目光。

    “她一个人扛了三年？”

    王峰点点头，眼眶有些发红：
content_en:
Alchemy Peak.

"I called you here today because I have something to tell you!"

At the party table, Lu Chen, Lin Tian, Zhang Fan, Yu Ning, Zhuang Jingbai and others all sat together and looked at the man at the head, Wang Feng.

He is the chief disciple of Alchemy Peak.

"What's going on, Senior Brother Wang, you've called us all over, such a big battle!" Zhang Fan asked after drinking a glass of spiritual wine.

"I... reconciled."

"What?!" Everyone was shocked, thinking they heard wrong.

"You are teasing us, senior brother. You and Senior Sister Huaiyu have such a good relationship and live so happily. You are the couple of gods and gods. How can you reconcile?"

"It's true, it's my problem...Oh, it's all the fault of the damn black market, it's all the blame of the damn Acacia Sect!!"

Wang Feng took a deep breath and looked at him with hatred.

When Lu Chen heard this, his body trembled slightly.

"What's going on? Senior Sister Huaiyu, there's no way she could betray you!"

"Hey, I won't be afraid of your jokes if I say it!"

Wang Feng sighed.

"I was born with poor quality, and the probability of having it was very small, so I found a folk remedy on the black market, which said it was to take both Jiang Huaiyu's and mine out of the body."

"Isn't this normal? Could it be that something happened later?"

"Yes, it was normal at first, but who knew..."

Speaking of this, Wang Feng looked painful.

"Who knew that people in the black market secretly replaced mine with that person's!!"

As soon as these words came out, the scene suddenly became quiet.

Because they did not expect that things would develop like this, and the most important thing is that senior sister Jiang Huaiyu did not make any mistakes, she was also a victim.

"Brother, you..."

Zhang Fan opened his mouth, but for a moment he didn't know what to say.

He subconsciously looked at Yu Ning beside him, who was also shocked and a little pale.

My hands are shaking!

Lin Tianze frowned and put down the spirit wine in his hand: "Senior Brother Wang, does...Senior Sister Huaiyu know about this?"

"She knows." Wang Feng smiled bitterly.

"She knew it earlier than I did. When Ling'er was three years old, she discovered something was wrong, secretly went to verify it, and found that it was indeed not the case! But she didn't dare to tell me, and she had to carry it alone for three years."

"Three years?" Zhuang Jingbai looked back at Lu Chen.

"She carried it alone for three years?"

Wang Feng nodded, his eyes a little red:
